en.content: Number of compounds from the following with zero dipole moment is _________.
en.explanation:
A molecule has zero dipole moment when its bond dipoles cancel by symmetry (or when bonds are nonpolar).

Species Shape (VSEPR) Dipole moment? Reason
HF linear nonzero polar bond, no cancellation
linear zero homonuclear, nonpolar
bent nonzero bent shape → net dipole
linear zero symmetric linear cancellation
trigonal pyramidal nonzero lone pair breaks symmetry
trigonal planar zero symmetric planar cancellation
tetrahedral zero symmetric tetrahedral cancellation
tetrahedral nonzero not symmetric ( and )
tetrahedral zero symmetric tetrahedral cancellation
bent nonzero bent shape → net dipole
linear zero symmetric linear cancellation
